periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Delivered prevention lessons to 1,650 students using interim materials. District review of the new grade 6 through 9 curriculum is behind schedule. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Complete the district review and schedule summer teacher training.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Lessons reached 2,100 students. The district finished its curriculum review in June but asked for revisions, and teacher training is set for August. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Finalize the curriculum, train 28 teachers before school opens, and start lessons in every middle school.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Finalized the prevention curriculum for grades 6 through 9 and trained 28 teachers before the school year opened. Lessons are running in all middle schools and at three youth centers. Partners: Harborview Unified School District, Education department, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Collect teacher feedback on the first unit and add a vaping module for ninth grade.
